note: The corpus's assertions that are red at HEAD, each owned by an open task. This is a NAMED LIST and deliberately not a ceiling: a ceiling lets one task pay the debt and the next task spend it, which is the reasoning cli/test/assertion-debt.test.mjs was built on. Every entry here is a case source-corpus.test.mjs reports rather than fails on — so the suite can live in the gate without crying wolf (docs/agents/cli.md) while still holding the assertion the SH338 order says must land before the fix. The list is checked in BOTH directions: an entry whose assertion has gone green FAILS the run, naming the id to delete. That is what stops the list becoming the place findings go to be forgotten.

findings.what: The generated layout emits {{CSS}} with two braces inside the getRelation block, so a captured stylesheet reaches the browser with every url() entity-escaped.
SectionHero.ctaHref holds https://awkward.test/docs/guia — an absolute href extracted whole, which the render-time rebase correctly leaves alone.

scanPage reads <title> into the page row without decoding its entities, so a source title of `Awkward &amp; company` is stored verbatim and escaped again on render. <title> is RCDATA, not raw text — SH550's exclusion was written for <script> and <style>.
buildInventory drops the redirectedTo that visit returns, so /antigo and /docs/guia/ are two pages with the same body and no record that one is the other's redirect.
